description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Industrial Disputes between E. Jeewagan vs. Lanka Sugar (Pvt) Ltd.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the Industrial Disputes Act and contains orders made under Section 4(1) of this legislation. It includes the revocation of a previous order and the appointment of arbitrators to settle industrial disputes, which constitutes regulatory action under existing labor laws. The content focuses on legal procedures, statutory powers, and regulatory framework implementation rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
